description: Tarea Integradora Final — Workshop Morning Readiness Briefing. Documento maestro: especificación de tarea (estudiante) + instrumento de evaluación (Escala No 6) + guía de preparación S7 + condiciones de administración S8.

task_specification.title: The Workshop Morning Readiness Briefing
task_specification.subtitle: Final Mission — Guía 1.1

scenario.context: The Training Coordinator arrives for the morning inspection. Your team of 3 must deliver the complete Bay Readiness Briefing in English before the first diesel truck of the day enters the bay.
scenario.context_es: El Coordinador de Formación llega para la inspección de apertura. Tu equipo de 3 debe presentar el Informe Completo de Alistamiento del Bay en inglés antes de que entre el primer camión diesel del día.
scenario.bay: Asignado por el instructor — Bay 1, 2 o 3

characters.CARLOS: Lead Technician / Supervisor — abre el briefing, da instrucciones al equipo, recibe el reporte final
characters.VALENTINA: Apprentice — describe condiciones, solicita herramientas, reporta al supervisor
characters.SANTIAGO: Technician — responde solicitudes, describe condiciones adicionales, confirma instrucciones

task_requirements: Duración: 3–4 minutos exactos (mínimo 3 min / máximo 4 min — cronometrado en S8)
Las 5 funciones comunicativas deben ser visibles — mínimos por rol según tabla de roles
≥ 15 términos del Toolbelt distribuidos entre los 3 roles (cada término distinto cuenta una sola vez)
Mínimo 3 intercambios directos entre miembros del equipo (no 3 monólogos independientes)
There is / There are + preposición de lugar en mínimo 3 oraciones
Bay number identificado al abrir el briefing
Cierre limpio: 'Bay ___ is ready. Briefing complete.' o equivalente

key_actions: Abre el briefing con saludo + identificación del bay
Da 2 instrucciones al equipo usando imperativos
Hace la pregunta de seguimiento al recibir el reporte
Describe al menos 2 condiciones del bay con There is/are + preposición
Entrega el reporte final de estado del bay a Carlos
Describe una condición adicional del bay
Confirma al menos 2 instrucciones o acciones completadas

F2.name: Requesting tools/help
F2.structure: 'Can I have the torque wrench?' / 'I need the socket set.'

F3.name: Describing conditions
F3.structure: There is/are + preposition: 'There is a spill near the bay door.'

F4.name: Reporting to supervisor
F4.structure: 'Bay ___ is ready, Carlos.' / 'There is a problem with ___.'

toolbelt_20_reference.tip: Tip: 'Preventive maintenance checklist: complete.' cubre 3 términos en una sola frase — eficiente y profesional.

not_permitted: Role Card (solo para revisión previa a la performance, no durante)

lines.speaker: CARLOS
lines.line: Valentina — check the floor jack. Santiago — PPE check.

lines.speaker: SANTIAGO
lines.line: Got it. I'll do it now.

lines.speaker: VALENTINA
lines.line: Santiago, can I have the torque wrench?

lines.speaker: SANTIAGO
lines.line: Here you go. And — there are two wrenches on the workbench.

lines.speaker: VALENTINA
lines.line: There is an oil spill near the bay door. I'll clean it now.

lines.speaker: CARLOS
lines.line: Clean it now. Then check the fire extinguisher.

lines.speaker: SANTIAGO
lines.line: The fire extinguisher is next to the bay door. OK.

lines.speaker: VALENTINA
lines.line: Bay 2 is ready, Carlos. Checklist: complete. Preventive maintenance scheduled.

lines.speaker: CARLOS
lines.line: Good work. Bay 2 — briefing complete. Team dismissed.

model_assets.note: The model uses 10 terms — a real team should aim for 15+. Expand by adding: safety goggles, gloves, ratchet, socket, calibration, work order, toolbox, hazard, etc.

stock_card_a_bay_status.title: Stock Card A — Bay Status Options
items: Tools on workbench: wrench / ratchet / socket / torque wrench
Floor jack: OK — no leaks / needs attention
Fire extinguisher: next to bay door / missing

stock_card_b_sentence_starters.title: Stock Card B — Sentence Starters
starters: Good morning. This is the Bay ___ Readiness Briefing.
There is a ___ on / under / next to / near ___.
The ___ is on / under / next to / near ___.
The floor is clean. / There is a spill near ___.
I check the ___. No leaks. The lift works.
Bay ___ is clean. Bay ___ is safe. Bay ___ is ready.

evaluation_instrument.reference: Escala de estimación No 6 — see PM-4.1 INST-6 for full printable form
evaluation_instrument.title: Escala de Estimación No 6 — Final Mission: The Workshop Morning Briefing
evaluation_instrument.evaluator: Instructor como Training Coordinator (rol externo — no interviene durante la performance)

criteria_summary.criterion: Todas las 5 funciones comunicativas visibles y correctamente usadas (F1–F5)
≥ 15 términos del Toolbelt distribuidos entre los 3 roles
Interacción genuina de equipo: ≥ 3 intercambios directos (no monólogo)
Corrección gramatical: There is/are + preposiciones + imperativos
Pronunciación comprensible de los 5 términos target
Cumplimiento de tarea: 3–4 min, bay identificado, cierre limpio

evaluation_instrument.scoring: Suma de 6 criterios (1–5 cada uno) ÷ 6 = puntaje holístico 1–5. Puntaje máximo: 5/5.
evaluation_instrument.follow_up_question: Una pregunta sorpresa por equipo al cierre del briefing — del banco de preguntas (ver PM-4.1 INST-6).

scale_reference.2: En proceso — visible pero con errores significativos
scale_reference.1: No logrado — no visible o completamente incorrecto

s7_prep_summary.title: Session 7 — Preparation Protocol

rounds.output: Peer feedback: functions observed + Toolbelt count + duration + 1 strength + 1 suggestion

rounds.focus: Incorporate feedback — second full run — new peer observer
rounds.output: Comparison: did you address Round 1 weaknesses?

rounds.focus: Dress rehearsal — instructor as Training Coordinator
rounds.output: Written feedback card + follow-up question to prepare for S8

s7_prep_summary.between_rounds: Targeted mini-drills on class-wide gaps (F3 expansion / team interaction / Toolbelt density / pronunciation)

role_card_guide.title: Role Card — What to Include
sections: My 3 key sentences (MY OWN WORDS — not copied from model):
My 5 Toolbelt terms I will use: ___, ___, ___, ___, ___
My cue (what Carlos says that triggers my first line): ___
My transition (how I pass the floor): ___
My answer to the follow-up question: ___
role_card_guide.note: Role Card is a preparation tool, not a script. By S8, the lines should feel natural, not memorized. Do NOT hold or read the Role Card during the performance.

tasks: Read Role Card aloud once — time your portion (~60-80 sec of the 3-4 min total)
Prepare 2-3 sentence answer to the follow-up question from S7 Round 3 Feedback Card
Practice the 5 pronunciation targets in full sentences — once without notes

administration_guide_s8.title: S8 Administration Protocol — Instructor
pre_performance: Room cleared centrally — performance space visible to all
Instructor seated at side as Training Coordinator — not at front
Performance order posted on board (drawn in S7 or assigned)
8-minute silent Role Card review — instructor does not speak
Team 1 moves to performance area when silent review ends
during_performance: Silence — instructor marks Escala No 6 in real time
Timer starts when Carlos speaks first word
At 4:30 min: instructor says 'Close the briefing' if team has not finished
One prompt allowed if team completely freezes: say the bay number aloud (e.g., 'Bay 2'). Note in form.
after_each_performance: Ask one follow-up question from the bank
Wait for answer — mark impact on Criteria 1 and 4
Observer team shares one observation aloud (30 sec)
Next team moves to performance area
post_all_performances: Instructor exits Training Coordinator role explicitly: stands, moves to front, says: 'I am your instructor now.'
One whole-class observation: functions, terms, team interaction — what was seen across all teams
administration_guide_s8.feedback_return: Escala No 6 with written comments per criterion returned per institutional timeline. Individual written comment required (not just numerical score).
